Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: jayteealao
Message:
feat(football-manager-match-engine): implement data-schemas-generator

Validated content files replace the built-in teams and the unbounded tuning:
a fail-closed JSON loader with garde rules names the file and the field on
every refusal; attributes become a fixed array with derived values computed
at load; a seedable generator writes fictional clubs and produced the two
shipped defaults; owner.id and match.id ride in stats.json and in tick-file
header schema 2. The command line gains --content-dir, --team-a, --team-b,
and generate, and carries four probe fixes. 65 tests, clippy and rustfmt
clean; benchmark 390 ms against the 393 ms baseline.
